decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir fits the firm's core hydraulic steel engineering business, costs little to keep listed, and one year on the market is too little to settle its uncertain prospects, so the option stays open.

The energy management system lies outside the core and resembles the digital fouling products the firm already dropped, but with only one year of mentions its value is still unresolved and keeping it costs little, so it is kept for now.
The overflow flap gate has its own dedicated page, which shows a further commitment within the core business, and nothing so far suggests its value is unlikely to be realized.
